route: No independent-means route. Migrationsverket's 'You want to apply' list covers EU/EEA citizens, living with someone, work, visiting, study, permanent residence, citizenship, protection and long-term residents. Closest is the visitor's residence permit for tourists: 'limited so that the total time you are permitted to be here is no more than six months' ... 'You are not allowed to work or settle here.' It needs 'at least SEK 700 for each day' and 'medical travel insurance' (recommended at least EUR 30,000, valid in all Schengen countries).
policy: No route to settle, so no statutory cover for the couple. A resident would be in county healthcare with patient fees. I did not retrieve the fee ceiling or any insurer tariff.
